instruction: How to get the ArgoCD server URL from ingress
output: kubectl get ingress -n argocd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argocd-server -o jsonpath='{.items[0].spec.rules[0].host}'

How to install ArgoCD on a Kubernetes cluster
output: kubectl create namespace argocd && kubectl apply -n argocd -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/stable/manifests/install.yaml

instruction: How to install ArgoCD high-availability

How to configure ArgoCD with an external URL
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"url":"https://argocd.example.com"}}'

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD with TLS certificates
output: kubectl create secret tls argocd-server-tls --cert=server.crt --key=server.key -n argocd

instruction: How to enable the ArgoCD repo-server to use a proxy
output: kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"reposerver.proxy":"http://proxy:8080"}}'

instruction: How to restart ArgoCD server after config change
output: kubectl rollout restart deployment argocd-server -n argocd
